body:
We are missing a control for browsers and platforms with a capabilities / permission model (a la iOS, MacOS, ChromeOS, etc). In particular, where the browser asks permission to access the camera, microphone, or location data. The code should not ask for permissions it does not need. 

“10.2.6 Verify that the application does not ask for permissions to unnecessary privacy related features or sensors, such as contacts, cameras, microphones, or location.”

comments.body: This would be a L2 control.

title: New requirement - V10.2.x ask for only permissions you need
